labels.description: Vendor-VPN login at 3 a.m. followed by new unsegmented RDP connection to Water Plant SCADA.
Water SCADA received sudden inbound RDP connection from Vendor VPN at 3 a.m.
High-velocity port scan across internal DMZ, Hospital BMS, and Traffic signal endpoints.
Unusually large outbound SMB data transfer (gigabytes) from Historian Mirror to workstation.
Never-before-seen CIP programming connection on port 44818 initiated from Corporate Workstation.
Corporate Workstation directly transmitting EtherNet/IP control packets to Substation RTU.
